derivation: by rw [upperRightHom_apply, isParabolic_mk_iff, GeneralLinearGroup.IsParabolic, SpecialLinearGroup.coe_GL_coe_matrix, Matrix.isParabolic_iff_of_upperTriangular] <;> simp [SpecialLinearGroup.transvection_coe]
explanation: The Mathlib lemma characterizes parabolic upper-triangular 2×2 matrices by equality of the diagonal entries and nonvanishing of the upper-right entry. Applied to the transvection representing `upperRightHom x`, those conditions simplify to `x ≠ 0`; the quotient and coercion rewrites bridge the PSL statement to the matrix lemma.
